text:
harper_ops: @here quick announcement: rolling out a tiny dedicated V440 pool in Auckland (akl1) as a limited preview for APAC customers. Pool id: `dedicated-V440-akl1-preview`. Starting cards: 6. Goal: reduce p95 for NZ/AUS traffic and validate region routing. :nz:

jin_pm: Nice. Any deviations from our usual preview behavior (billing, SLA, reservations)?

harper_ops: Preview pricing applies (discounted trial). Reservations allowed via CLI/Console. No SLA change for preview. Important: fallback chain is akl1 -> sydney-syd1 -> hosted-global. We'll emit fallback events to the Console analytics.

isabel_sre: Rollout timing and probes? Need to add to SRE dashboard and paging rules.

harper_ops: Canary starts 2026-09-01T04:00Z for 45m, then scale to preview. Probes: `akl1-v440-smoke` and `akl1-v440-p95`. Pause criteria: fallback > 6% in any 15m window OR error-rate > 0.5%. Runbook (internal): https://redwood.internal/runbooks/v440-akl1-preview.

rachel_sales: I'll notify pilot customers in ANZ and add migration notes. Is there a CLI snippet recommended for CE to show customers?

harper_ops: Use this example to reserve cards:

```
# reserve 2 cards in akl1 for 10 days
rb-reserve --pool dedicated-V440-akl1-preview --size 2 --duration 10d
```

emily_ce: Will runtime images include optimized kernels and quant profiles for V440, or do customers need to recompile?

isabel_sre: Shipping two tuned profiles (v440-fp8 and v440-int8-lite) on the images. Nonstandard model configs will require a one-time compile; the reservation flow shows a compile-warning. We also added a note in the Console that compile may add ~1-3 minutes to first run.

jin_pm: Can we add a banner to the Console during canary: "akl1 V440 preview may fallback to SYD1 during the canary window" and link the runbook?

harper_ops: Banner + runbook link will go live 15m before canary. Also enabling detailed fallback traces for 72h post-rollout.

deploy-bot: Deployment kicked off for pool `dedicated-V440-akl1-preview` at 2026-09-01T04:00:12Z (canary).

harper_ops: Ops anchors for first 24h: watch token p95 latency, fallback %, KV cache hit-rate, and first-token latency for streamed responses. If fallback spikes above threshold we halt scale and investigate network/placement.

emily_ce: Can we schedule a 20m walkthrough for CE+Sales tomorrow 08:30 PT to rehearse demos and migration steps?

rachel_sales: I'll prep a short FAQ: migration steps, billing note, expected latencies, and what to tell customers if they hit a compile warning.

harper_ops: Calendar invite sent. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
